Exploud

Normal

Hoenn · Generation 3

Exploud is a Normal-type Loud Noise Pokémon first found in Hoenn (Generation 3). It stands 1.5 m tall and weighs 84 kg. It evolves from Loudred. Its highest base stat is HP (104), with a base stat total of 490.
